title: Your agent is blindfolded — Johan Lajili, Poolside AI
talk_summary: Johan Lajili argues the gap between AI success and failure stories is the feedback loop: agents claim work is done without being able to verify it, so brownfield work fails. He built a custom CLI harness (Spoolside) that lets the agent drive the real app, extract logs, restart services, and reproduce bugs before fixing them, and urges engineers to build such harnesses themselves.

takeaways.what_they_do: Require the agent to reproduce a bug through the real app harness before it is allowed to write a fix; otherwise the fix is untrusted.
takeaways.evidence_quote: until it reproduces the bug, I don't trust you

takeaways.what_they_do: A custom CLI exposes high-level app actions (navigate, send message, upload, wait for reply) plus log extraction and service restarts so the agent can exercise the product like a user.
takeaways.evidence_quote: ways to restart different services, high level commands. Can you access a specific menu?

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of raw screenshots/DOM, feed the agent a compressed snapshot of the page state, analogous to GStack-style tooling.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a very token compressed version of what's going on on a web page

takeaways.what_they_do: Periodically feed agent logs back to an AI and ask it to spot smells (e.g. repeated sleep calls, repeated commands) and turn them into harness improvements.
takeaways.evidence_quote: look past over your logs, ask an AI, did you notice any issues, any any stink?

takeaways.technique: Invest in harness before scaling agents
takeaways.what_they_do: Treat making the AI self-verifying as a prerequisite investment before multiplying agents or running overnight.
takeaways.evidence_quote: You need to make sure that it's self-served before you try to work on features

takeaways.what_they_do: Prefers harness flows that mimic how a human tests the app over brittle scripted assertions, and when the human spots a defect, converts it into a harness capability so the AI finds it next time.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I take a step back and try to think on how to make the AI realize the problem by itself
